_README: GENUINE seed filings used to populate the page before the live FSA EDINET ingester runs. Every row is a real large-shareholding (大量保有報告書/変更報告書) data point pulled from the EDINET-DB cross-reference (March 2021+) or, for Miri, from confirmed EDINET filings. `current_pct` = holding ratio at this filing (percent). `change_pp` = change vs prior filing in percentage points (null for an initial report). build_data.py derives previous_pct, move_type, filing_type, ids and summaries. base_date is the filing reference date; the live ingester replaces these with true submission dates + EDINET document IDs + canonical source URLs.
source: EDINET large-shareholding reports via EDINET-DB cross-reference (edinetdb.jp); Miri rows from EDINET filings confirmed via kabutan.
